item.title: Reece Kershaw given new undisclosed job at St John Ambulance
item.description: Former Australian Federal Police commissioner Reece Kershaw has been hired by St John Ambulance NT in a new undisclosed role, following the appointment of a new chief executive, while both the NT branch and St John Ambulance Australia declined to respond to an allegation that a preferred CEO candidate was put forward by the federal body and rejected by the NT organisation.

item.title: NT Criminal Court list – with charges – Feb 16
item.description: The 259 names facing criminal courts in the Northern Territory for Monday, February 16, 2026. This list includes all the charges.

item.title: AFP investigating dysfunction in NT Police top brass
item.description: EXCLUSIVE: The NT Police top brass is currently under investigation by a senior member of the Australian Federal Police, the NT Independent can reveal, who was recently sworn in to conduct a probe into "allegations against a number of people up on the top floor".

item.title: Nightcliff byelection set for March 7
item.description: The byelection to select the next Member for Nightcliff will be held on March 7, with the Greens and Labor announcing their candidates out of the gate, while the CLP is yet to put a candidate forward.

item.title: Machete fight on Alice Springs Council lawns ends in arrests, one in hospital
item.description: One person was taken to hospital with cuts to his back and three others were arrested after a machete fight through the Alice Springs CBD on Friday afternoon, NT Police said, while other offenders remain at large.

item.title: NT Criminal Court list – with charges – Feb 17
item.description: The 248 names facing criminal courts in the Northern Territory for Tuesday, February 17, 2026. This list includes all the charges.

item.title: Se Acabo: ‘None of that worries me’
item.description: OPINION: David Connolly's response in 2023 to being called a 'bigot', a 'racist', a 'chauvinist', 'intolerant' and 'small-minded' was that “none of that worries me”, which is consistent with Mr Connolly and the CLP Government remaining unperturbed about his appointment as NT Administrator while the politics of division continue to damage our democracy, writes John Lawrence.

item.title: Infant allegedly assaulted by mother in remote community
item.description: An infant was taken to hospital in Alice Springs Sunday night after allegedly being assaulted by her 20-year-old mother in a remote MacDonnell Region community, NT Police said, while an investigation into the matter is currently ongoing.

item.title: NTEC says ‘no evidence’ Styles returned his political donations on time
item.description: There is "no evidence to substantiate" Darwin Mayor Peter Styles' claims that he returned his mayoral campaign donation list in person before the deadline for disclosures lapsed, the NT Electoral Commission has said, following an internal review.

item.title: Bullying allegations against CLP MLA a ‘sensitive HR matter’ that needs to be kept quiet, Chief Minister claims
item.description: Bullying allegations against CLP MLA Tanzil Rahman made by two female parliamentary staffers have "been resolved" as part of a "sensitive HR matter", Chief Minister Lia Finocchiaro has claimed, but questions remain over how the situation was handled and what the Chief Minister knew about the allegations.
